result.title: Simultaneous Competitive and Regret Guarantees for TCP Acknowledgment
result.summary: We study simultaneous competitive and regret guarantees for TCP acknowledgment. Each acknowledgment serves all pending packets, and the objective is to minimize the total acknowledgment and waiting costs. It is well known that no deterministic online algorithm achieves a competitive ratio better than $2$. Given $k$ randomized online experts and $0<\varepsilon<1$, we construct a randomized online algorithm whose realized total cost is always at most $(2+\varepsilon)$ times the offline optimal cost $\mathrm{OPT}$ and whose expected regret against the expert with the smallest realized cost is $O(\sqrt{\mathrm{OPT}\log(k+1)}+\log(1/\varepsilon))$. The algorithm requires no advance knowledge of the number of packets or $\mathrm{OPT}$. Our algorithm controls switching costs between experts and uses the gap between the permitted competitive bound and its current cost to determine when to learn. We also prove lower bounds showing that, for $k\ge 2$, this regret bound is asymptotically optimal in $\mathrm{OPT}$, $k$, and $\varepsilon$, and that $\varepsilon>0$ is necessary for sublinear regret.

AI.brief_summary: 研究 TCP 确认的在线算法：在(2+ε)竞争比约束下，用多个随机专家构造同时保证竞争比与对最优专家 regret 为 O(√(OPT log k)) 的算法，并给出下界。
AI.relevance_reason: 「用竞争上界与当前成本的差距决定何时学习」的预算约束式元决策，可能可供核查 LVR 中动态计算预算下的 THINK/STOP 时机与停止准则设计。
